description: This file defines a C++ interface for a dictionary-like data structure within the WPEFramework, including nested notification and iterator interfaces, with methods for registering observers, retrieving, and setting key-value pairs within namespaces.

classes.name: IDictionary
classes.description: Interface for a dictionary with namespace support, change notification, and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: IDictionary::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about modifications to the dictionary namespace.

classes.name: IDictionary::IIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over key-value pairs within a dictionary namespace.

methods.name: Modified
methods.description: Called when a namespace is modified, providing the namespace name, key, and new value.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next item.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns the key at the current iterator position.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the value at the current iterator position.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for a specific namespace.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for a specific namespace.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in a namespace.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value for a given key in a namespace.

methods.name: Get (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse all key-value pairs in a namespace.

ctags.name: IDictionary
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IDictionary : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IIterator
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IIterator : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
